Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

DeepEP V2 sizes per-expert masked GEMM buffers using the configured maximum dispatch capacity across all source ranks, even for small CUDA Graph batches. These buffers are retained by captured graphs and can cause out-of-memory failures during capture.

## Modifications

- Bound masked GEMM buffers by the current source-token upper bound, accounting for worst-case routing, uneven TP shards, Graph padding, and GEMM alignment.
- Apply the tighter bound when EP spans the full TP group with attention DP/CP disabled; retain the existing capacity for other topologies.
- Keep communication buffers unchanged, with no additional collectives, device-to-host synchronization, or model-specific conditions.
- Add focused capacity and topology-fallback coverage to the existing CPU lifecycle tests.

## Accuracy Tests

- All **11 CPU lifecycle tests** passed. Four-rank GPU checks cover worst-case routing, uneven shards, and CUDA Graph replay.
- GLM-5.3-Flash, **4 × H200, TP4/EP4**, ordinary prefill/decode: GSM8K, **1,314 examples × 2 runs: 96.0%, 95.9%**. Model validation includes #46225 and #46424 for independent KDA/GDN padding and DSA output-layout fixes; neither is a code dependency of this allocation change.

```bash
python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/layers/moe/test_deepep_v2_buffer_lifecycle.py
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Capture comparison with an **8,192-token prefill chunk**, default model context length and attention TP gather, `mem_fraction_static=0.85`, and a decode Graph limit of 64:

| Metric | Baseline | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Decode CUDA Graph capture | OOM while capturing bs56, after bs64 completed | All 10 capture sizes completed |
| Complete Graph memory per GPU | Unavailable: capture failed | **2.90–2.91 GiB** |
| Available memory per GPU after capture | Unavailable | **17.28 GiB** |

The baseline failed when allocating a **4.50 GiB** masked GEMM workspace with approximately **3.11 GiB** free. This PR completed capture at the same settings. Memory values above use framework capture logs; no complete baseline Graph-memory total or percentage reduction is reported because its capture failed.

Reproduction command (model path and serving address replaced):

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 \
EP_DISABLE_GIN=1 \
SGLANG_DEEPEP_V2_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=2048 \
python -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path /path/to/GLM-5.3-Flash \
  --served-model-name llm \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tp-size 4 \
  --ep-size 4 \
  --moe-runner-backend deep_gemm \
  --moe-a2a-backend deepep_v2 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
  --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 \
  --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang \
  --dsa-decode-backend tilelang \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \
  --max-mamba-cache-size 320 \
  --max-running-requests 64 \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 \
  --cuda-graph-bs-decode 1 2 4 8 16 20 24 32 40 48 56 64 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 8192 \
  --reasoning-parser glm45 \
  --tokenizer-worker-num 4 \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 8000 \
  --random-seed 42
```

The per-rank dispatch capacity is 2,048 for this TP4/chunk8192 configuration. `EP_DISABLE_GIN=1` selects the non-GIN communication path used for validation. After TP alignment, the actual captured sizes are `[4, 8, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64]`. The command uses default context length and attention TP gather and does not override `max_prefill_tokens`.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -2524,7 +2524,8 @@ def expand_to_masked_slab(
         NUM_WORKERS=num_workers,
         num_warps=4,
     )
-    # Capture relies on max_m = cap * ep_group_size; eager also checks counts.
+    # Capture relies on max_m covering every source token that could route to
+    # one expert; eager also checks the actual counts.
     if check_overflow and int(overflow.item()) != 0:
         raise RuntimeError(
             f"DeepEP v2 masked slab overflow: an expert received more than max_m="

@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@
 )
 from sglang.srt.runtime_context import (
     get_exec,
+    get_parallel,
     get_resources,
 )
 
@@ -300,6 +301,33 @@ def _validate_common(
                 f"got {topk_ids.shape[1]}"
             )
 
+    def _masked_token_capacity(self, local_tokens: int, ep_group_size: int) -> int:
+        capacity = self.num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank * ep_group_size
+        parallel = get_parallel()
+        # Without attention DP/CP, sources in the TP group share a batch:
+        # inputs are replicated or tensor_split shards differing by at most
+        # one row. Other topologies may have larger remote batches.
+        if (
+            parallel.attn_dp_size != 1
+            or parallel.attn_cp_size != 1
+            or parallel.tp_size != ep_group_size
+            or parallel.tp_group is None
+            or self.group is not parallel.tp_group.device_group
+        ):
+            return capacity
+
+        # A token selects an expert at most once. Even if every source routes
+        # every token to one expert, its count cannot exceed the source total.
+        # Round up for the masked GEMM layout; never enlarge the original slab.
+        # Include the possible extra row on each other tensor_split shard.
+        source_total = max(1, local_tokens * ep_group_size + ep_group_size - 1)
+        aligned_total = (
+            (source_total + _EXPERT_ALIGNMENT - 1)
+            // _EXPERT_ALIGNMENT
+            * _EXPERT_ALIGNMENT
+        )
+        return min(capacity, aligned_total)
+
     def dispatch(
         self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, topk_output: TopKOutput
     ) -> DeepEPv2DispatchOutput:
@@ -410,8 +438,9 @@ def dispatch(
                 (local_tokens * ep_group_size * self.router_topk + self.num_experts)
                 // self.num_experts,
             )
-            # Every rank can send its full dispatch capacity to one expert.
-            masked_max_m = self.num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank * ep_group_size
+            # Only the GEMM slab shrinks; ElasticBuffer and collective dispatch
+            # keep their configured capacity and existing handle geometry.
+            masked_max_m = self._masked_token_capacity(local_tokens, ep_group_size)
             total_expanded = recv_capacity
 
         # Publish ownership only after the returned metadata is validated.

@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 """CPU-only tests for the DeepEP v2 ElasticBuffer ownership facade."""
 
 import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
 from unittest.mock import patch
 
 import torch
@@ -150,6 +151,36 @@ def test_dispatch_capacity_guard_uses_actual_input_rows(self):
         with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "per-rank buffer capacity"):
             impl._validate_common(torch.empty(5, 128), torch.zeros(5, 2))
 
+    def test_masked_capacity_covers_source_rows_and_graph_padding(self):
+        impl = object.__new__(deepep_v2._DeepEPv2Impl)
+        impl.group = _FakeGroup()
+        impl.num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank = 1152
+        parallel = SimpleNamespace(
+            attn_dp_size=1,
+            attn_cp_size=1,
+            tp_size=4,
+            tp_group=SimpleNamespace(device_group=impl.group),
+        )
+        with patch.object(deepep_v2, "get_parallel", return_value=parallel):
+            for rows, expected in ((0, 128), (160, 768), (264, 1152), (1152, 4608)):
+                with self.subTest(rows=rows):
+                    capacity = impl._masked_token_capacity(rows, 4)
+                    self.assertEqual(capacity, expected)
+                    self.assertGreaterEqual(capacity, min(4608, rows * 4 + 3))
+
+            # Rank-local rows cannot bound other sources in these topologies.
+            for overrides in (
+                dict(attn_dp_size=2),
+                dict(attn_cp_size=2),
+                dict(tp_size=8),
+                dict(tp_group=None),
+                dict(tp_group=SimpleNamespace(device_group=_FakeGroup())),
+            ):
+                with self.subTest(overrides=overrides):
+                    topology = SimpleNamespace(**(vars(parallel) | overrides))
+                    with patch.object(deepep_v2, "get_parallel", return_value=topology):
+                        self.assertEqual(impl._masked_token_capacity(160, 4), 4608)
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
